title: Chupa Chupa beams at Colares

tellings.quote: As it was flying, the object would cast down a beam of light.

plain: In 1977 at Colares, in the Brazilian state of Pará, a flying object nicknamed the Chupa Chupa would cast down a beam of light as it flew. Aldo Rebelo, a former Brazilian defense minister, describes this to Michels in an episode on Brazil's best-known UFO cases. Coming from a former minister, it would mean an official is backing the account of the beams.
